content.en_US:
Reclaimed industrial oil can be obtained through [[processing|Chemical Plant]] [[industrial oil|Industrial Oil]]. It can be used as an ingredient in [[petroil|Petroil]] or as a [[fuel|Fuels]] source for supplemental power.
